mods.title: Advanced Box System
mods.author: FAFF0x
mods.summary: Modernizes Bill's PC with instant box switching, direct party/box swaps, animated Pokemon row icons, and a rich selected-Pokemon stats/moves preview in Gen1 Modern UI.

mods.title: Area DexNav
mods.author: FAFF0x
mods.summary: Press SELECT in the overworld to encounter an uncaught Pokemon from the current area's real encounter table.

mods.title: Ashes of Cinnabar
mods.author: FAFF0x
mods.summary: A Quest System-compatible adventure unlocked after the Volcano Badge. Explore a burning laboratory beneath Pokemon Mansion, unlock security doors, recover secret files, survive an environmental timer and defeat a Ditto experiment that copies the player's party.

mods.title: Battle Art Voxel Fork
mods.author: absol89
mods.summary: A fork of the Dramatic Shape voxel mod aimed at battle art: animated back sprites, selectable sprite generations, and sprite fallback for other sprite mods.

mods.title: Catch Helper
mods.author: FAFF0x
mods.summary: Whole-number catch HUD with a name-anchored owned marker and corrected Ultra Ball progression.

mods.title: Crystal 251
mods.author: Deftones565
mods.summary: Optional expanded-species integration referenced by FAFF0x manifests.

mods.title: Crystal Onix: The Living Crystal
mods.author: FAFF0x
mods.summary: Adds Crystal Onix as a Rock/Ice Onix variant shown as #95C directly beneath #095 ONIX in both the stock Pokédex and Pokédex Plus (when installed), with a fully integrated quest and perfect-DV/max-Stat-EXP reward.

mods.title: DV EV Editor
mods.author: FAFF0x
mods.summary: Adds an out-of-battle DV and Stat EXP editor to the Pokemon party submenu, with optional Gen1 Modern UI presentation and a START shortcut that instantly maximizes all DVs and Stat EXP for the selected Pokemon.

mods.title: Echoes Beyond the Fog
mods.author: FAFF0x
mods.summary: A one-shot post-game lighthouse mystery inspired by the anime giant Dragonite episode, with nine handcrafted dungeon floors, visible interaction markers, optimized dormant quest logic, and fully safe Bill dialogue delegation that preserves the Cell Separator and vanilla chat.

mods.title: EXP Share Modes
mods.author: FAFF0x
mods.summary: Adds selectable Off, Classic Even Split, and Modern Progressive EXP sharing modes.

mods.title: Free Master Ball
mods.author: FAFF0x
mods.summary: Adds Master Ball to every Poké Mart and sets its buy price to 0.

mods.title: FREE RARE CANDY
mods.author: FAFF0x
mods.summary: Adds RARE CANDY to every standard Poké Mart and makes it completely free.

mods.title: Gen1 Modern UI
mods.author: ArmstrongThomas
mods.summary: Repaints the menus in full window space — responsive dialogue, Party, PC, Trainer Card, Pokedex, Bag and Shop, with themes and a minimal mode.

mods.title: Guaranteed Catch
mods.author: FAFF0x
mods.summary: Makes every registered Poke Ball catch successfully, regardless of HP, status or species catch rate.

mods.title: HM Anywhere
mods.author: FAFF0x
mods.summary: Use owned HMs without teaching them. All field HMs are available from Start -> HM; contextual A-button CUT/SURF/STRENGTH can be toggled on/off, with NPC interaction priority while surfing.

mods.title: Item Shortcut
mods.author: FAFF0x
mods.summary: Assign five Bag shortcuts, use one FAST item instantly, and remap any keyboard or controller input by pressing it.

mods.title: Kanto Achievements
mods.author: FAFF0x
mods.summary: Adds 100 obtainable achievements with search/filter navigation, detail pages, unlock notifications, and optional Gen1 Modern UI presentation support.

mods.title: Modern Bag
mods.author: FAFF0x
mods.summary: Modern inventory pockets with configurable opening tab, hold-to-fast-scroll, Favorites, pinned items, unlimited capacity, touch-friendly keyboard search, TM/HM tools, and optional Gen1 Modern UI presentation.

mods.title: MODERN BATTLE UI
mods.author: FAFF0x
mods.summary: Pokemon-inspired modern battle interface with fully mirrored move-learning prompts, source-accurate forget-list selection, direct mobile touch controls, responsive Android/iOS layouts, trainer SHIFT and level-up overlays, caught markers, optional battle log, Party/Bag/Summary, effectiveness, item descriptions and animated EXP.

mods.title: Modern UI Fix
mods.author: FAFF0x
mods.summary: Runtime compatibility patch for Gen1 Modern UI 0.8.x-0.9.x. Preserves authored Pokemon icons/Pokedex art and fixes battle UI suppression, including a hard full-uiCanvas restore for live BATTLE_ART_VOXEL_FORK staged battles.

mods.title: Move Inspector
mods.author: FAFF0x
mods.summary: Shows type, PP, power, accuracy, effectiveness and STAB for the highlighted battle move. Works with classic and wide battle layouts.

mods.title: Move Learn Stats
mods.author: FAFF0x
mods.summary: Shows POWER and maximum PP while choosing a move to forget, with Gen1 Modern UI support and compatibility with Crystal 251 / other MoveLearnMenu decorators.

mods.title: Moves Manager
mods.author: FAFF0x
mods.summary: Adds a MOVES page to the Pokemon party submenu with move details, memory, reordering, legal replacement, and optional Gen1 Modern UI presentation.

mods.title: New Game Plus
mods.author: FAFF0x
mods.summary: Post-League New Game Plus with stronger trainers and wild Pokemon, Gym Leader rematches, optional bosses, rewards, and repeatable difficulty cycles.

mods.title: NEW ICONS
mods.author: FAFF0x
mods.summary: Replaces all 251 Gen 1 and Gen 2 party/menu Pokemon icons with the supplied full-color two-frame animated icon set, including compatibility with Crystal 251 and other content overhauls that register their own species icons.

mods.title: NEW ITEM ICONS
mods.author: FAFF0x
mods.summary: Adds full-color item sprites to Bag, Shop and PC item lists. TM/HM artwork is selected dynamically from the taught move's type.

mods.title: NEW SPRITES
mods.author: FAFF0x
mods.summary: Replaces large Pokemon preview artwork with full-color animated sprites for all 251 Gen 1 and Gen 2 Pokemon. Gen 1 retains front/back animation; Gen 2 uses the supplied animated front sprites and falls through to the active content mod for back sprites.

mods.title: Nickname Changer
mods.author: FAFF0x
mods.summary: Adds a RENAME option to the Pokémon party submenu so any party Pokémon can be nicknamed directly from the menu.

mods.title: Performance Monitor
mods.author: FAFF0x
mods.summary: Advanced FPS/per-mod fluidity profiler with sandbox-safe attribution and mod.storage JSON/TXT diagnostic exports for current Gen1Recomp.

mods.title: Poachers in the Safari Zone
mods.author: FAFF0x
mods.summary: A Quest System-compatible Safari Zone operation unlocked after the Soul Badge. Track illegal poachers with a temporary team of rescued Safari Pokemon, evade patrols, survive traps and choose a perfect rare Pokemon reward.

mods.title: Pokédex Plus
mods.author: FAFF0x
mods.summary: Enhances the Pokédex with search, stats, habitats, evolutions, moves, regional-style shared-number variants, and pokemon.icon rows compatible with the original Modern UI 0.8.x via Modern UI Icon Fix.

mods.title: Quest System
mods.author: FAFF0x
mods.summary: A reusable, performance-optimized quest journal with objectives, rewards, persistent tracking, cached NPC indicators and optional Gen1 Modern UI presentation.

mods.title: Repel Reuse Prompt
mods.author: FAFF0x
mods.summary: Asks whether to use another Repel when the current Repel wears off.

mods.title: Reusable Machines
mods.author: FAFF0x
mods.summary: Makes TMs reusable, forces HM moves to be forgettable in the normal move-learning menu, and displays each TM/HM move name directly in the Bag.

mods.title: Rocket Gym Ambushes
mods.author: FAFF0x
mods.summary: After each Gym badge, a vanilla Team Rocket trainer appears near the Gym. Defeat them and recruit one Pokemon from their team.

mods.title: Summon
mods.author: FAFF0x
mods.summary: Adds SUMMON to the Start menu with a true Modern UI numeric keypad and wild encounters.

mods.title: Team Rocket Returns
mods.author: FAFF0x
mods.summary: A multi-city post-Giovanni Team Rocket quest with investigations, scaled battles, a hidden laboratory and a Rocket Case menu entry that disappears after completion.

mods.title: The Abandoned Cabin
mods.author: FAFF0x
mods.summary: A Quest System-compatible adventure unlocked after the Thunder Badge. Follow a sailor's report to an abandoned Route 11 cabin, solve a generator puzzle, defeat a maximum-stat Magneton experiment and rescue a perfect Electabuzz.

mods.title: The Black Flower
mods.author: FAFF0x
mods.summary: A Quest System-compatible adventure unlocked after the Rainbow Badge. Help Erika explore a corrupted secret garden, survive black spores, defeat possessed Grass Pokemon and destroy the Black Flower's Victreebel guardian.

mods.title: The Empty Throne
mods.author: FAFF0x
mods.summary: A Quest System-compatible final Rocket adventure unlocked after the Earth Badge. Descend beneath Viridian Gym, survive an elite succession gauntlet, make consequential moral choices and defeat Commander Vesper. v1.0.2 safely delegates vanilla Gym Guide dialogue whether MapScripts.baseTalk returns a ScriptRunner table or Lua function.

mods.title: The Mirage of Mew
mods.author: FAFF0x
mods.summary: A post-Earth Badge adventure through Pokemon Mansion, Pokemon Tower, Viridian Forest and Seafoam Islands to encounter and catch Mew.

mods.title: The Sixth Bell
mods.author: FAFF0x
mods.summary: A Quest System-compatible horror mission unlocked after earning six Badges. Includes persistent completion recovery, conflict-safe Lavender Town interaction, Gengar reward, and zero-overhead palette handling while inactive or completed.

mods.title: The Stolen Fossil
mods.author: FAFF0x
mods.summary: A Quest System-compatible investigation unlocked after the Boulder Badge. Accept it from Pewter Museum's accessible front-desk guide, track thieves into Mt. Moon and choose Omanyte or Kabuto.

mods.title: The Three-Stone Covenant
mods.author: FAFF0x
mods.summary: A quest unlocked after any three Gym Badges with robust save detection, three elemental trials and all three Eevee evolutions as rewards.

mods.title: Trade Evolution Fix
mods.author: FAFF0x
mods.summary: Converts the four Generation I trade evolutions into level evolutions at level 40.

mods.title: Universal Free TM Shop
mods.author: FAFF0x
mods.summary: Adds a dedicated free TM Shop to every Poke Mart. Clerks offer the normal shop or a separate catalogue containing all Generation I TMs at no cost.

mods.title: Whispers Beneath Cerulean
mods.author: FAFF0x
mods.summary: A Quest System-compatible adventure unlocked after the Cascade Badge. Explore a custom canal dungeon beneath Cerulean, activate three valves, defeat contaminated Water Pokemon and rescue a Starmie with maximum DVs and EVs.

relationship_fields.optional_dependencies: Dependencies explicitly declared optional by the mod manifest.

index_notes.download_policy: Author-hosted downloads only. No ROMs or mirrored mod ZIP binaries.
